text.title: API Contract Pattern Selection Decision Tree
text.summary: Routes on three signals visible before any style is picked — whether the boundary is still open, whether every consumer speaks the server's language, and whether client and server share one build and one deploy — to the rule that rules a style in or out.

decision-tree.root-question: Is the contract style genuinely still open — the API has not served production traffic under an existing style for more than six months, and the boundary leaves the process?

branch.when: live consumers on an existing style for 6+ months, or the call never leaves the process

conclusion.verdict: skip; this is a migration costed by the client rewrite, or an in-process function call with no wire contract — emit a structured skip naming which condition held

branch.when: new or unreleased boundary; the style is a real choice
branch.question: Is any expected consumer written in a language other than the server's?

branch.when: at least one consumer is in a different language
branch.question: What does that cross-language consumer list actually demand?

branch.when: tooling_needs contains sdk-gen, mock-server, contract-test or doc-portal

conclusion.verdict: verdict must resolve to a generator-readable artefact (OpenAPI 3.1, GraphQL SDL or .proto) and name its repo path

branch.when: a browser is on the consumer list and grpc is the leading candidate

conclusion.verdict: grpc is admissible only with a named translation layer (Envoy grpc-web, Connect or grpc-gateway) and a named operator, as a setup ticket

branch.when: several client-shaped views over one graph, with callers outside the team

conclusion.verdict: graphql-sdl is admissible only with max query depth, a cost limit with its budget, and persisted queries or an allow-list — all three in the artefact

branch.when: team_boundary is external and more than one breaking change is expected per quarter

conclusion.verdict: the artefact must name the style's one supported evolution story — URL major plus deprecation window, @deprecated plus additive-only, or reserved field numbers

branch.when: plain request/response, no generator tooling, no browser gRPC

conclusion.verdict: restrict the verdict to a language-neutral schema document (openapi-3.1, graphql-sdl, grpc); trpc and undocumented json-rpc are invalid here

branch.when: every consumer shares the server's language
branch.question: Do client and server compile in the same TypeScript build and ship in the same deploy?

branch.when: one build graph (monorepo or workspace package) and coupled release

conclusion.verdict: trpc is admissible; record the build-graph and deploy-coupling evidence that makes it valid, since losing either invalidates the verdict

branch.when: the client can ship against a server version it was not compiled against

conclusion.verdict: apply the full methodology; trpc is out on the deploy-coupling test — score openapi-3.1 against tooling_needs and evolution_rate and emit the artefact for review
